review.gallery: 15 visually reviewed native-resolution project renders extracted from the Cedarwood Estates-branded brochure. Individual villa front/rear labels follow the brochure’s four-, five- and six-bedroom pages. Common interiors are described as published for the phase, with no claim of a delivered unit. No stock lifestyle cutaways, blank background textures or card badges are used.
review.location: The original phase-specific typology map is retained with its key and source page. Current official shared-page journey estimates were checked on 7 November 2026. The shared embedded map provides no verified phase entrance, so named directions are used. https://www.wasl.ae/en/project/cedarwood-estates
review.floorPlans: Three complete sheets show the original phase’s three villa families and all levels. The printed saleable figures are retained. Their floor components total 6,105, 7,656 and 9,178 sq ft, against printed totals of 6,070, 7,918 and 9,471 sq ft. Wasl must reconcile these areas for the selected villa. South phase figures are kept separately. All printed numerical panels and original whole pages were visually reviewed. Broker-hosted copies remain explicitly labelled in the page’s source metadata.
review.provenance: Fresh fetch receipts with SHA-256 and exact source kind are in artifacts/project-page-enhancement/wasl-sources.log. Original PDFs and visual evidence are retained per project. Original text research and protected ownership are preserved.

unavailable: A direct developer-hosted phase brochure or separate current plan pack was not exposed on the reviewed public page or search. The source copies remain labelled by their actual host.
Reliable phase-specific visitor-entrance coordinates and dated construction photographs were not established. Existing source arithmetic conflicts remain explicit.
